key.name: position
key.description: Screen edge of the primary monitor the dock is attached to.

key.name: alignment
key.description: Where the dock sits along its screen edge. Start is left for a bottom dock and top for a side dock.

key.name: show-apps-button
key.description: Whether the dock has a button that opens the app grid.

key.name: show-apps-at-start
key.summary: Show Apps button at the start
key.description: Place the Show Apps button before the app icons instead of after them.

key.name: icon-size
key.description: Size of the icons at rest, in pixels.

key.name: enable-magnification
key.description: Whether icons near the pointer grow.

key.name: max-scale
key.description: How much the icon under the pointer grows, as a multiple of the icon size.

key.name: dock-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the dock background, from 0 (transparent) to 1 (opaque). Icons are not affected.

key.name: icon-spacing
key.description: Extra space between icons, in pixels.

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Radius of the dock's corners, in pixels.

key.name: enable-blur
key.description: Show a blurred copy of the wallpaper behind the dock.

key.name: blur-sigma
key.description: Standard deviation of the blur, in pixels.

key.name: blur-brightness
key.description: Brightness of the blurred wallpaper, from 0 (black) to 1 (unchanged).

key.name: intellihide
key.description: Slide the dock off screen while a window overlaps it, and stop reserving screen space for it.

key.name: hide-delay
key.description: Time before an overlapped dock hides after the pointer leaves it, in milliseconds.

key.name: show-delay
key.description: Time the pointer must rest on the screen edge before a hidden dock appears, in milliseconds.

key.name: click-action
key.summary: Click action for the focused app
key.description: What clicking the icon of the focused app does: cycle through its windows, minimize them, minimize a single window and cycle through several, or nothing.

key.name: scroll-to-switch
key.description: Whether scrolling over an app icon switches between that app's windows.

key.name: dock-padding
key.description: Space between the icons and the border of the dock, in pixels.

key.name: show-separator
key.description: Whether a line separates pinned apps from other running apps.

key.name: show-running-dots
key.description: Whether a dot marks the apps that are running.

key.name: running-apps-order
key.description: How running apps that are not pinned are ordered: by the order they were started, or by name. Either way the order never changes on its own.

key.name: show-in-overview
key.summary: Replace the dash in the overview
key.description: Keep the dock on screen in the overview and hide the shell's own dash, so that the same bar is shown everywhere.

key.name: show-trash
key.description: Whether the trash sits at the end of the dock. Its icon tells whether it holds anything, and its menu empties it.

key.name: show-downloads
key.description: Whether the downloads folder sits at the end of the dock, before the trash. Its menu lists the files changed last.

key.name: show-places-separator
key.description: Whether a line is drawn between the apps and the downloads folder and trash.

key.name: stacks-fan-view
key.description: Whether clicking the downloads folder fans its latest files out of the icon instead of opening the folder.
